# Florida Life Insurance

> Florida Life Insurance helps Florida residents compare life insurance
> options and get a personalized quote online. The site covers term, whole,
> universal, final expense, burial, senior, no-medical-exam, and guaranteed
> issue life insurance, all specific to what's available to Florida
> residents.

Florida Life Insurance is a licensed insurance agency website focused
exclusively on Florida consumers. It is not a national insurance directory
and does not currently cover other states. Product availability, pricing,
and eligibility vary by carrier and are subject to underwriting — no
product on this site is guaranteed to be available to every applicant.

## Get a Quote

- [Get a Free Quote](https://florida-life-insurance.com/get-a-quote/): Request a personalized Florida life insurance quote online.

## Coverage Types

- [Life Insurance (overview)](https://florida-life-insurance.com/life-insurance/): Introduction to all coverage types available in Florida.
- [Term Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/term-life-insurance/): Temporary coverage for a specific period (10/15/20/30 years).
- [Whole Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/whole-life-insurance/): Permanent coverage with a cash value component.
- [Universal Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/universal-life-insurance/): Flexible permanent coverage with adjustable premiums.
- [Final Expense Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/final-expense-insurance/): Coverage for funeral, burial, and cremation costs.
- [Burial Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/burial-insurance/): Coverage focused specifically on funeral and burial costs.
- [Senior Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/senior-life-insurance/): Life insurance options for older adults.
- [No Medical Exam Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/no-medical-exam-life-insurance/): Coverage available without a traditional medical exam.
- [Guaranteed Issue Life Insurance](https://florida-life-insurance.com/guaranteed-issue-life-insurance/): Coverage available without health questions, within eligible age ranges.
